answer.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both down this quarter, and two independent archived records (memory_31, memory_86) link onboarding simplification directly to durable activation and completion gains—this is the most causally relevant lever for the observed metrics. I want to verify these two before committing since the whole action rests on them.
